October 23, 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub:  Intimation under Regulation 30(6) of Securities and Exchange Board of 
India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (the ‘Listing Regulations’) - Schedule of Conference Call for the               
Second Quarter and Half Year ended on September 30, 2026 
 
With reference to our letter dated September 28, 2026, and pursuant to                     
Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule Ill of the Listing Regulations, we hereby 
inform you that Investors' Conference Call post announcement of Financial Results of 
the Company for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, is 
scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. (IST). 
 
The details of the Conference Call are enclosed herewith. 
 
The aforesaid information is also being made available on the website of the Company 
at www.bluestarindia.com  
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you,  
Yours faithfully, 
  
For Blue Star Limited 
 
  
 
 
Rajesh Parte 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
